Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02913-7

A new system will help scientists to refine large language models for longevity research and clarify ‘biological’ age.

Nature.title: Exclusive: New evidence for hidden chambers beyond Tutankhamun’s tomb
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02621-2

Geophysical survey yields ‘tantalizing’ data that could point to Nefertiti’s burial place — but it’s too early to draw definitive conclusions.

Nature.title: Take a risk or play it safe? Neuronal tug-of-war helps the brain decide
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02911-9

Using a video game involving bombs and treasure chests, researchers show how neural activity flickers between two regions of the frontal cortex when the brain weighs up a tricky decision.

Nature.title: How a team of AIs discovered a promising lung-cancer drug
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 17 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02954-y

Researchers developed a ‘virtual biotech’ made up of as many as 37,000 agents reporting to an 'chief scientist'.
